messages:
maya: Morning bridge here — I'm primary for the next 3h. Noticed two active pagers this morning (one sev2 latency, one sev3 embed errors). @sam @evan pls ack and standby.

sam: acked. i'm online as backup. what's the current customer impact?
ev: sev2 is hitting hosted text-gen p99 ~3.2s for a subset of clients, error rate up ~15% in the pooling layer. fallback model reduces latency but increases cost.

incident-bot: [pager] sev2 - text-gen latency - 4285712345 - paging @eng-oncall @sre

maya: quick triage summary: looks like batching backlog on a dedicated pool + Redis KV eviction noise. Priya, can you run a quick mem/eviction check and paste results? runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/latency-backlog

priya: running checks now. cmd i'm running: ```kubectl top pods -n inference && redis-cli info | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'``` will paste output in a sec.

priya: redis evicted_keys=4321, used_memory=87% -> likely eviction. pods: inference-gg-3 at 100% cpu, inference-gg-2 at 78%.

maya: short mitigation (fast path):
1) scale inference pool +1 replica (reduce batching backlog)
2) route 20% traffic to fallback-lt model to lower p99 while we stabilize
3) flush non-critical ephemeral caches that are getting evicted
4) monitor p99 and error rate for 10-15m
Runbooks: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/scale-pool , https://runbooks.redwood.ai/fallback-routing

sam: scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gg --replicas=4 -n inference` — i'll confirm when ready.

deploy-bot: deployment inference-gg scaled to 4 replicas by sam at 4285712390 :rocket:

sam: scaled. verifying pod readiness and tail logs.

maya: after scaling please also toggle route policy to send ~20% traffic to fallback-lt. You can do this from the Console quick-toggle or: `redwood route update --policy latency_fallback --weight 20%`

sam: toggled routing to fallback (20%) via console :thumbsup:

evan: customer impact note: 4 mid-market tenants reported latency spikes to CS; we've queued comms and told them we're investigating. If we need more aggressive action, can switch to quantized fallback (runbook).

priya: quick remediation steps I executed: 1) scaled pool 2) restarted hot pod inference-gg-3 (`kubectl delete pod inference-gg-3 -n inference`) 3) flushed ephemeral keys `redis-cli --scan --pattern ephemeral:* | xargs -r redis-cli del` 4) confirmed error-rate dropped to ~2% on those tenants.

maya: tidy actions + owners: sam -> observe scaling, verify p99 on dashboard and adjust route weight (obs board). evan -> customer comms & updates to CS. priya -> follow up on redis eviction root cause & eviction policy. maya -> escalate to SRE if p99 > 2.5s after 15m and consider broader fallback.

oncall-bot: handoff reminder: next primary @evan at 4285712700 — please confirm early handoff if issue still open.

maya: i'll post a status update in 15m and leave these runbook pointers. @evan can you take the primary if still unresolved at handoff? :wave:

evan: will take if it's still open. thanks all, monitoring now.
